# OrchestrAI Control Plane submission

`test-playbooks-orchestrai.yml` (dispatch and nightly) and `!orc`
(`orchestrai-pr-command.yml`) start their runs through the OrchestrAI Control
Plane CI API, using a GitHub OIDC token rather than a stored OrchestrAI token.
Detect & Trigger starts one run per hardware batch and waits until the Control
Plane has started that batch's pipeline build. Each `Test <playbook> (<os>/<device>)`
job then waits on the build, reads its `summary.json` and reports that playbook.
Test Gate (Required) aggregates the jobs.

The tested source is `amd/playbooks` at `playbook_ref` (default `main`), or the PR
head for `!orc`, pinned to a commit SHA before submitting.

## Reporting switch

- `reportportal` (default, and the nightly unless `ORCHESTRAI_REPORTING` says
  otherwise): the Control Plane also publishes each run to ReportPortal with the
  workspace credential `ORCHESTRAI_V2_RP_CREDENTIAL` (project
  `ORCHESTRAI_V2_RP_PROJECT`). The publish is required. Each job links the launch.
- `api`: results stay in OrchestrAI; each job links the OrchestrAI run.

Pass/fail per playbook is the same in both modes.

## Configuration

Repository variables: `ORCHESTRAI_V2_CI_API_URL`, `ORCHESTRAI_V2_OIDC_AUDIENCE`,
`ORCHESTRAI_V2_PORTAL_URL`, `ORCHESTRAI_V2_WORKSPACE` (the workspace slug),
`ORCHESTRAI_V2_RP_CREDENTIAL`, `ORCHESTRAI_V2_RP_PROJECT`, and optionally
`ORCHESTRAI_REPORTING`, `ORCHESTRAI_V2_LINUX_IMAGE` / `ORCHESTRAI_V2_WINDOWS_IMAGE`.
`ORCHESTRAI_PIPELINE_USER/TOKEN` (secrets) are still needed: the Test jobs read
the pipeline builds.

The workspace CI access rules must trust `amd/playbooks` with:

- `.github/workflows/test-playbooks-orchestrai.yml@<ref>` for `workflow_dispatch`
  and `schedule`;
- `.github/workflows/orchestrai-pr-command.yml@refs/heads/main` for
  `issue_comment` (`!orc` always runs from the default branch).

Cancelling the GitHub run does not cancel started runs; the Control Plane run
timeout bounds them.
